The '''''Lumpy Bantha''''' was a [[720 light freighter/Legends|720 light freighter]] manufactured by [[Ghtroc Industries/Legends|Ghtroc Industries]]. It was armed with a single [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannon]] in one weapon mount, and [[Quad laser cannon/Legends|quad laser cannon]] in the other. Unfortunately, the quad laser's power requirements meant that when it was activated, it drew power from another system at random, shutting that system down.
